CustomField.description: Derived (SDD Pricing-COLA 6.2): TRUE when COLA_Uplift_Percent__c differs from the stamped Default_COLA_Uplift_Percent__c. Formula field replacing the prior trigger-maintained checkbox, so the override classification is computed from a single definition. Guarded so a line with no stamped default (or no percent) is not treated as an override.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Indicates whether the COLA percentage differs from the default (derived).
CustomField.label: Is COLA Overridden
